Since the report says "perforated," "Material Perforation" is the closest fit, though "Material Rupture" remains possible.

Moderate paravalvular leak around a transcatheter valve is a leak around the outside of the valve, so it is a leak problem. Intravalvular regurgitation would be leakage through the valve, which does not fit. Paravalvular leak with TAVR is usually coded as "Device Endoleak" or as the general leak label; I take "Leak/Splash" as the parent, since Device Endoleak more usually refers to stent grafts.
